mapper.insert: INSERT INTO fund_data_quality_issue ( id, sync_run_id, dataset, source, source_time, business_date, fetch_batch_id, data_version, checksum, record_key, quality_status, reason_code, raw_summary, detected_at, issue_status, create_time, update_time ) VALUES ( #{item.id}, #{item.syncRunId}, #{item.dataset}, #{item.source}, #{item.sourceTime}, #{item.businessDate}, #{item.fetchBatchId}, #{item.dataVersion}, #{item.checksum}, #{item.recordKey}, #{item.qualityStatus}, #{item.reasonCode}, #{item.rawSummary}, #{item.detectedAt}, #{item.issueStatus}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ) ON CONFLICT (dataset, fetch_batch_id, record_key, reason_code) DO UPDATE SET sync_run_id = EXCLUDED.sync_run_id, source = EXCLUDED.source, source_time = EXCLUDED.source_time, business_date = EXCLUDED.business_date, data_version = EXCLUDED.data_version, checksum = EXCLUDED.checksum, quality_status = EXCLUDED.quality_status, raw_summary = EXCLUDED.raw_summary, detected_at = EXCLUDED.detected_at, issue_status = EXCLUDED.issue_status, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
mapper.select: SELECT id, sync_run_id, dataset, source, source_time, business_date, fetch_batch_id, data_version, checksum, record_key, quality_status, reason_code, raw_summary, detected_at, issue_status FROM fund_data_quality_issue WHERE record_key = #{fundCode} OR record_key LIKE (#{fundCode}::varchar || ':%') ORDER BY detected_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT 20
